title: Preferring to play alone; end of tape
summary: He prefers to play alone, noting people praise you without knowing it is you; Russell ends the tape.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Would you rather play by yourself or have a drummer, a guitar or something with you? How do you feel?

Well, it used to feel good sometimes when you get the guitar and drumming all that alongside your corner when you be playing. It feels good. The best thing for a fella who was out there playing, he'd go on by himself.

Yeah, he'd go on by himself. And his praise would be getting, he'd get it. There are people talking about you, about you playing four or five days or maybe five or six years. There are people talking about you and they'd be talking about you and they wouldn't know it was you. You'd be right there sitting down and listening down. And they wouldn't know it's you. They heard you playing. They wouldn't know it.
They wouldn't recognize you. They'd be talking about you and you'd be sitting down there listening to that.
That's about the end of this tape.
